invariants.rationale: A new TextureRegion is always constructed and returned, so result is never null.
The returned object is always a TextureRegion.
The argument is used as a key for images.get(name); keys are usually non-null in map lookups to prevent NullPointerException.
The TextureRegion is constructed using images.get(name), so its texture is equal to the value in the map for the given name.
